integrity: All mathematical claims are derived from stated assumptions and exact signs. Generalized Descartes and Atkinson formulae are credited to prior mathematics. Historical Atkinson sensitivity studies are not claimed as new; relevant inaccessible material is explicitly identified.
scientific_limitations: Equal-weight, equal-mean positive-income profiles only; no unequal population weights, zero incomes, other inequality indices, or empirical causal effects. Root uniqueness follows analytically; decimal approximations are not proof.
title: Four households are the sharp threshold for double Atkinson inequality-rank reversal
